newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil unchanged on steady futures, premiums.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil unchanged on steady futures, premiums.

text.p: NWE gas oil was broadly unchanged on Tuesday as premiums remained steady and futures were flat.
May IPE traded steady at $165.00 a tonne at 1100 GMT.

Diesel was better talked than heating oil with cargoes around May IPE +$11-13 cif NWE while barges were around May IPE +$11-12 fob ARA. The firmness was attributed to tight supplies and summer spec premiums, in past years around +$4-5, may stay strong this season. "It will be the first summer without Russian diesel available in large quantities, so there it may remain tight," said one trader.
But some dealers said it was a short-term shortage.
Russian cargo premiums were holding around May IPE +$2 cif NWE while DIN attracted interest around May IPE +$3 cif NWE.
Heating oil barge premiums were unchanged with offers on Rotterdam refinery material at May IPE +50 cents for second half April and 50 cents stronger for first half May.
A second half April barge was heard sold at May IPE +25 cents.
